theme_strategy: Dark mode primary to enhance the futuristic 'Godly-level' AI/IoT Dashboard feel, while grounding the aesthetics with organic, earthy undertones (Deep Forest/Moss) to represent the environmental/animal welfare mission. The required brand color #90EE90 (Petzzy Green) will act as an electric, glowing accent for primary actions, live indicators, and data visualizations.

rules: Import fonts via Google Fonts or Fontshare.
Headings (Cabinet Grotesk) must use tight tracking (`tracking-tight` or `tracking-tighter`).
Overlines and small labels must be Uppercase, Tiny, and Wide Spacing (`tracking-[0.2em]`).
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
CRITICAL: The brand primary is #90EE90. When used as a background for buttons or badges, text inside MUST be dark (e.g., #0A140E) for WCAG AA contrast compliance.
Avoid pure black (#000000). Use the specified dark green-tinted blacks.

surfaces.headers: Use 'Crystal Glass' - `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A140E]/70` with a 1px delicate bottom border (`border-[#1B3324]`). Never use fully transparent.
surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background (`bg-card`) with a sharp 1px border (`border-border`). On hover, apply `-translate-y-1` and `shadow-lg`.
surfaces.ai_camera_cards: Use 'Grid Borders' or a subtle 'Tracing Beam' effect to signify active AI processing. Add a pulsing 'LIVE' green dot.

spacing_and_layout.marketing_pages: Use the 'Bento Grid' (Mode A). Asymmetrical grids, wide gaps (`gap-8` to `gap-12`). Generous padding (`p-12`, `p-24`).
spacing_and_layout.dashboard: Use High-Density Grid (Mode B). Tight gaps (`gap-4` or `gap-6`). Utilize every pixel. Use `h-full` to stretch elements evenly.
general: Images must not exceed `max-h-[80vh]` on mobile.

pages_and_features.name: Landing Page
pages_and_features.details: Hero section with tagline 'PETZZY', About Us (mission/problem/team), How It Works/Tech (AI cameras, IoT, solar), and Contact. Use parallax scroll and rich bento-box layouts.

pages_and_features.name: Auth (Login/Register)
pages_and_features.details: Split screen layout. One side has a large vertical image of puppies/dogs, the other side is the form. Include Google SSO button + JWT email/password form.

pages_and_features.name: User Dashboard
pages_and_features.details: Leaflet + OSM map showing nearby bins. Stats on bin fill %. Live AI camera feeds (looping videos with CSS bounding boxes for 'dog/cat detected').

pages_and_features.name: Management/Admin Portal
pages_and_features.details: SaaS-like data density. Tables of registered users (with 'Download Excel' button), list of bins with GPS coords, food pellet levels, last-fed stats, sensor/battery health.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. Primary button uses `#90EE90` background with dark text. Include `hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-95 transition-transform`.
components.map: Use `react-leaflet` with OpenStreetMap. Custom map markers styled with the PETZZY green color.
components.data_table: Use shadcn/ui table. Must be dense, clean, and highly legible.
components.ai_camera_feed: Simulated using standard HTML5 `<video autoPlay loop muted>`. Overlay absolutely positioned standard `div` elements with neon green borders to simulate AI object detection tracking boxes.

images.description: Two puppies carrying a stick in a grassy field.
Dogs sitting on top of a pile of dirt - authentic street environment.

images.category: Tech / How It Works - Solar Panels

media_and_assets.icons: Use `lucide-react` or `@phosphor-icons/react` for high-end duotone tech aesthetics.

rules: Apply staggered entrance animations to dashboard lists using `framer-motion`.
Hover states must alter both background color and text color explicitly.
Do NOT use universal `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-transform`, `transition-colors`.
Add `data-testid` to ALL interactive and key informational elements.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold: create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (`transition: all`).
Do NOT center align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`). Keep natural left-aligned reading flow.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings, subtle scale changes).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
For .js file environments, do not include TypeScript interfaces or type annotations in the code.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
Shadcn components use .js / .jsx format. Override rigid shadcn defaults to fit the organic/tech PETZZY theme.
